_comment: Production live configuration, applied at boot by
updateFromConfigurationFile() (backend/src/init/configuration.ts). The
Dockerfile copies this to /app/backend/dist/backend-configuration.json,
which is the path that function resolves.
BASE_CONFIGURATION is secure-by-default: every feature ships OFF. That is
correct for the constant, but it is not a runnable product -- with the base
values nobody can sign up and no result can be saved. This file is the
deliberate, reviewable opt-in, so the deployed behaviour lives in git
rather than in a hand-edited Mongo document.
Only keys that differ from BASE_CONFIGURATION are listed. mergeConfigurations
merges by common key and same type, so anything omitted keeps its base value.
Deliberately NOT enabled:
admin.endpointsEnabled  - no admin UI ships; leaving it off keeps the
admin surface unreachable in production.
results.objectHashCheckEnabled and users.lastHashesCheck - anti-cheat
hash gates. Turning either on makes the backend
reject every result whose hash it recomputes
differently from the client, and that round trip
has no end-to-end test yet. Enable only together
with a test that submits a real client payload.
leaderboards.weeklyXp   - needs xpRewardBrackets designed first; an empty
bracket list would award nothing.
leaderboards.minTimeSpent - left at the AC-120.3 default of 7200 s.
